title: One-sample matroid prophet selection
exact_target: For every finite known matroid with mutually independent nonnegative weights and one independent sample from each unknown marginal law, can a distribution-free online selector achieve one fixed positive fraction of expected offline optimum, even when the measurable arrival order depends on both samples, all realized weights and the selector’s random seed? The expected optimum is assumed finite and no running-time restriction is imposed.
